instructions: Promote exactly the selected learning candidates from the lesson inbox into reviewable markdown artifacts. Create references/playbooks/failed-run-recovery-dogfood.md as a concise playbook promoted from references/lessons/inbox/2026-05-16T05-15-18-040Z-sdk-failed-recovery-dogfood.md. It must state when to use the playbook, required inputs, procedure, verification expectations, authority limits, and source evidence. The core invariant is: design failed-run recovery dogfood with fixable failures; the source run should fail because an artifact is incomplete, not because the verification command is permanently impossible. Create references/lessons/inbox/2026-05-21T07-03-46Z-frontend-visual-qa-consolidated.md as a consolidated lesson candidate from references/lessons/inbox/2026-05-16T05-21-22-haechi-native-companion-visual-qa.md and references/lessons/inbox/2026-05-16T08-39-19-haechi-reading-animation-css-cascade.md, with references to the related functional MVP vs submission readiness candidate. Keep it as a candidate, not a promoted playbook. It must preserve these lessons: brand-sensitive companion UI needs screenshot-driven visual QA; transparent character assets need alpha-aware compositing; frame or fallback UI bugs need computed style, layering, and screenshot or pixel-visible evidence; and functional MVP closure is separate from platform submission readiness. Do not delete, rewrite, or review the source candidates. Do not run lessons:review-inbox or update references/lessons/reviews/index.json. Do not change source code, tests, package configuration, run logs, worktrees, task specs, task templates, agent profiles, policy, doctrine, initiatives, operation reports, remote adapters, daemon/watch behavior, dashboards, routine triggers, hidden memory, or automatic promotion behavior.
